field_descriptions.csv_path: Absolute or repository-relative path to the CSV log for the run.
field_descriptions.method: Evaluation method or policy family, for example original, fixed_s085, windlevel_s085, or risk_adapter_v1.
field_descriptions.wind: Wind condition used for the run.
field_descriptions.goal_repeat: Number of goal publications used for the run.
field_descriptions.manual_collision_observed: True only when visual observation shows obstacle contact or clear physical blocking.
field_descriptions.manual_path_infeasible: True when the planned path visibly passes through an obstacle or occupied space.
field_descriptions.manual_obstacle_stop_observed: True when the UAV pauses or stalls at obstacle contact or apparent blockage.
field_descriptions.manual_teleport_after_collision: True when teleport-like fly-away follows an observed obstacle/collision interaction.
field_descriptions.path_through_obstacle_observed: True when the displayed planned path appeared to pass through an obstacle.
field_descriptions.path_feasibility_unknown: True when no visual evidence is available to judge path feasibility.
field_descriptions.collision_observed_time: Approximate first observed obstacle contact/blocking time in seconds, or null when not measured.
field_descriptions.annotation_source: Source of the annotation, such as manual visual observation, screen recording, or screenshot review.
field_descriptions.annotation_confidence: Confidence level for the manual annotation: low, medium, or high.
field_descriptions.divergence_failure_mode: Timing-based failure-mode label from divergence inspection when available.
field_descriptions.guarded_command_applied_later: True when guarded SO3 command blocking occurred after the earliest observed failure mechanism.
field_descriptions.manual_failure_note: Short free-form explanation of the observed path/collision evidence and timing.
